materials.basis: Uncalibrated cotton canvas cover base on a table.

bodies.mass_basis: Empty one-quart military canteen with screw cap in its canvas cover, no cup: cited bodies 0.136-0.15 kg (aluminium or plastic) plus covers 0.159-0.231 kg; 0.33 kg chosen.
bodies.inertia_basis: Hollow body: mass as a thin uniform shell over the closed collider surface (the enclosed space is not material) (work/band-mass.json).

components.basis: Military canteen from marso Library (Nvidia_HandOver); one rigid body

actions.description: Grip the canteen by its screw cap, lift it clear of the table and set it back down upright

tested_grasp.note: Single point actuator used in the scored proof; not a gripper.
